primary_question: Joint exact private representation, reply capacity, complete verification and update/lifetime cost under stated state and leakage budgets.
implementation_policy: Homemade deliverable arithmetic/protocols; external artifacts are pinned baselines and differential references.

gate_C_initial_targets.scope: Project decision thresholds, not promised gains or conference criteria; disclose all regressions and uncertainty.

tasks.title: Freeze exact-search contract
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: All candidates classified by data ownership, output, leakage, preprocessing, state and parameter assurance; justified outsourcing use case.
stop_or_pivot_if: State budgets invented solely to exclude local cache
tasks.execution_evidence: Contract frozen; outsourcing/state-budget usefulness still open, so full package acceptance is not declared.

tasks.title: Reproduce closest baselines
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Pinned native author modes and exact adaptations distinguished; inputs, outputs, assumptions, bytes and state retained.
stop_or_pivot_if: Borrowed paper speedups presented as local
tasks.execution_evidence: Two exact matched public fixtures, own anchors and 78 external CPU tests reproduced. Native vLHE/low-state code variants and publication-size samples remain.

tasks.title: Exact joint-representation oracle
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Every row/ID/capacity certified; exhaustive tiny cases; a joint-choice counterexample survives simple controls.
stop_or_pivot_if: Only rank reduction or ordinary merging explains benefit
tasks.execution_evidence: Exact finite grammar, all-row/ID capacity and independent integer/encrypted oracles implemented. Rank-only tradeoff found; novelty Gate B remains open.

tasks.title: Backend and security-dimension frontier
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Raw/global/local choices priced with actual code dimensions, response shares, client work, setup and integrity; nested vLHE oracle includes full-Q output, centered lifts/carries, explicit matrix expansion and outer parameter costs.
stop_or_pivot_if: Outer field width, matrix expansion, admissible-database bounds or preprocessing erase any replacement of owner mask-answer generation
tasks.additional_gate: P07 specifies composition assumptions before relying on outer verification or removing an existing inner check.
tasks.execution_evidence: E42 real code-floor models and E47 full-Q/carry/expansion oracle implemented. Reviewed outer composition and native low-state baselines remain.

tasks.title: Restricted-grammar representation planner
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Exact DP agrees with exhaustive grammar oracle; sufficient boundary state proof; bounded-search costs and gaps reported.
stop_or_pivot_if: Only a parameter sweep without mechanism
tasks.execution_evidence: Static boundary-state DP and exact finite frontier match exhaustive reference; uncertified rank beam misses recorded. Lifetime boundary-state proof/algorithm still open.

tasks.title: Update dependencies and token invalidation
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Insert/edit/delete preserve scores and IDs; no exposed-mask reuse; complete lifetime cost beats appropriate static/delta control.
stop_or_pivot_if: Fragment distributions or joint binding invalid after migration
tasks.additional_gate: P07 review required before remote untrusted deployment; local research oracles may precede it.
tasks.execution_evidence: Frozen-map fixed-ID encrypted pending-pad repair plus strong full-reencryption control implemented. Insert/delete/reserve, fragment sharing and durable migration remain.

tasks.title: Native complete-cost mechanism evaluation
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Gate C assessed on held-out data with setup, search, all prepared tokens, state and cache controls; model vs measured separated.
stop_or_pivot_if: Result depends only on favorable small public data
tasks.execution_evidence: Native complete update pilots include a 29.3% stage gain and a smaller-case regression. Initial+update gain about 15%; complete lifetime/real-data/uncertainty Gate C remains open.

tasks.title: Transcript and security reduction agenda
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Real/ideal transcript, leakage, hybrid premises, authentication, adaptive failure budget and parameter assumptions match code.
tasks.execution_evidence: Adaptive game, first-false-accept/hybrid outline, public digest leakage and seeded-XOF proof obligations documented. No complete reviewed reduction or assurance claim.

tasks.title: Authenticated lifecycle and optional factory
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Durable consume, concurrency, crash/retry, rollback, stale epochs and producer/provisioning costs exercised; attestation mode explicit.
tasks.additional_gate: Gate C practical-effect decision must pass before this task starts.

tasks.title: Optimize surviving native/CUDA path
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Gate C passed; public evaluator exact against references; full request and throughput measured with transfers and checking.
stop_or_pivot_if: Secret challenge/HE key reaches untrusted GPU
tasks.additional_gate: Gate C practical-effect decision must pass; P07 defines the complete verifier boundary before new GPU kernels.

tasks.title: Bounded alternate hypotheses
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: One exact independent oracle, closest-work delta, complete cost bound and negative control per promoted alternative.

tasks.title: Freeze paper evaluation artifact
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Selected-scope evaluation has pinned workloads, raw observations, environment, figures, uncertainty and negative results.
stop_or_pivot_if: Modeled network or capacity called measured
tasks.dependency_note: Record a scoped amendment if update, factory or GPU work is not part of the selected paper; never mark an omitted package complete.
tasks.execution_evidence: Raw runs, dependency locks, compiler/source/binary hashes and exact adapters retained; full frozen artifact/gates still open.

tasks.title: Validate claims and write paper
tasks.paths_note: Proposed unless already present; paths do not imply implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Claim-to-theorem-to-experiment-to-prior-work ledger supports one coherent contribution; independent key proof/parameter review.
stop_or_pivot_if: Novelty consists only of C++/CUDA optimization
Theorem assumptions do not describe implementation

historical_artifacts_policy: Do not rewrite prior measurements/manifests; validate their planning-document hashes at baseline_commit.
